summary: Air Products and Chemicals (China) offers a wide range of gases and gas-based solutions tailored for the semiconductor industry. Their products include bulk gases, specialty gases, and gas mixtures used in semiconductor manufacturing, display technologies, and other advanced materials processing. They also provide integrated gas supply systems designed for efficiency and reliability.
